d.tr: Can we meet if I come to Salem?
d.ctx: The user asks if they can meet in person if they visit Salem. The expert responds by asking what they would do.
d.j: Proposing to meet in person is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.tr: Will you give your WhatsApp number?
d.ctx: The user asks for the expert's WhatsApp number. The expert asks for clarification.
d.j: Asking for a WhatsApp number is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: நீங்கள் பே பண்ண ஓகேன்னா நான் வாட்ஸ்அப் நம்பர் கொடுக்க ரெடி
d.tr: If you are okay to pay, I am ready to give my WhatsApp number
d.ctx: The expert says they are ready to share their WhatsApp number if the user agrees to pay. The user responds by asking how much.
d.j: Proposing to move to an external app for payment is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.ctx: The user is complaining about other people on the app. The expert responds by asking for trust.
d.j: This is reported speech about what others do, not a direct request.

d.seg: உங்களுக்கு நம்பிக்கை இருந்தால் நம்பர் கொடுங்க நான் வாட்ஸ்அப் பண்ணுறேன்
d.tr: If you have trust, give me the number, I will WhatsApp
d.ctx: The expert asks the user to provide their number so they can WhatsApp. The user asks what they will do if they meet.
d.j: Proposing to move to WhatsApp is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: இது நம்பர் கொடுங்க என்னோடய வாட்ஸ்அப் நம்பர் கொடுங்க
d.tr: Give the number, give my WhatsApp number
d.ctx: The user insists on exchanging WhatsApp numbers. The expert asks if they will come on video call.
d.j: Asking for contact information is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.ctx: The expert asks if the video call will be nude. The user asks for the number.
d.j: Asking for nudity on a video call is a strong case for Explicit-Flirting.

d.ctx: The user asks if the expert will come on video call after paying. The expert asks about the amount.
d.j: Linking payment to a sexual service or video call is a strong case for SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: டெல் யுவர் வாட்ஸ்அப் நம்பர் தென் ஐ வில் ரியாக்ட் யூ
d.tr: Tell your WhatsApp number then I will react to you
d.ctx: The expert asks for the user's WhatsApp number again. The user starts dictating the number.
d.j: Asking for a WhatsApp number is a strong case for PlatformMove.

d.seg: நைன் ஃபைவ் டபுள் ஜீரோ நைன் டூ நைன் டூ த்ரீ நைன் எயிட் ஒன்
d.ctx: The user dictates their phone number. The expert confirms they have called/texted.
d.j: Providing a phone number is a strong case for PlatformMove.
